name: Leader Breakout & Pullback Strategy - All US
description: Buy strongest momentum leaders on breakout from tight consolidation or pullback to key moving average. Requires 50% gain over 126 days, aligned moving averages, favorable market regime (SPY > SMA50 with rising 10/20 SMAs over 5 days), 2:1 reward/risk, and $20M+ avg daily dollar volume for liquidity. Partial exit at 12% gain with stop moved to +0.5%, then hold as long as dynamic SMA exit criteria not met.
entry_rule: close >= 1 & close / lag(close, 126) >= 1.5 & close > sma_200 & sma_50 > sma_200 & sma_10 > sma_20 & sma_20 > sma_50 & spy_close > spy_sma_50 & spy_sma_10 > lag(spy_sma_10, 5) & spy_sma_20 > lag(spy_sma_20, 5) & rsi_14 >= 35 & rsi_14 <= 70 & volume >= vol_sma_20 * 1.2 & atr_20 / close >= 0.025 & avg_dollar_vol_20 >= 20000000 & (((high_20 - low_20) / close < 0.15 & close > high_20) | (abs(close - sma_10) / close <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_20) / close <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_50) / close <= 0.02))
entry_rule_long: close >= 1 & close / lag(close, 126) >= 1.5 & close > sma_200 & sma_50 > sma_200 & sma_10 > sma_20 & sma_20 > sma_50 & spy_close > spy_sma_50 & spy_sma_10 > lag(spy_sma_10, 5) & spy_sma_20 > lag(spy_sma_20, 5) & rsi_14 >= 35 & rsi_14 <= 70 & volume >= vol_sma_20 * 1.2 & atr_20 / close >= 0.025 & avg_dollar_vol_20 >= 20000000 & (((high_20 - low_20) / close < 0.15 & close > high_20) | (abs(close - sma_10) / close <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_20) / close <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_50) / close <= 0.02))
exit_rule: (abs(sma_10 - sma_20) / sma_20 > 0.05 & close < sma_10) | (abs(sma_10 - sma_20) / sma_20 <= 0.05 & close < sma_20)
